description: This file defines a controller class `Upgrade17` within the Opencart installation upgrade process. It contains logic to update user group permissions in the database by serializing and unserializing data, along with handling JSON responses for the upgrade step.

classes.name: Upgrade17
classes.description: Represents an upgrade step in Opencart version 17, extending the core Controller class, responsible for updating user group permissions during the upgrade process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method executed during the upgrade step; performs database permission updates and prepares a JSON response.
